column2: Strock: Herr General, while the rest of the Luftwaffe are busy with the ports of Liverpool and Glasgow, your mission is to destroy a munitions factory nearby. Unfortunately, you have a ground restriction, we are only able to land two of your ground units. The rest of the ground units you will have attached to you are Fallschirmjager units that have been inserted several days ago. Good luck.

von Beck: Sir, since we can only land two ground units, may I suggest that we land our recon units? As far as the Fallschirmjager units are concerned, there is a problem. In the process of acquiring ground transports, they have been compromised, and the British home guards are alerted. The good news is that they have stolen an AAA gun for our protection.
The Allies pushed us to the mountains, but we still keep the important passes.

Strock: Herr General, we are now in Operation Barbarossa. We have to neutralize Russia before we can conclude our war with England. We will do this by pushing back the Russian army far enough to keep their air forces from attacking our homeland and to deprive them of their use of naval bases. Good luck.

Strock: Herr General, with the success of Operation Barbarossa on all fronts, our leadership has decided to shift production away from guns and tanks to U-boats and aircraft. Therefore, our ability to resupply will be reduced significantly in the coming months. Take care of our equipment.
Major Mannheim (Logistics Officer): I have excellent news, sir. We have captured a fully operational Soviet tank, and we have plenty of ammunition to go along with it.

Strock: Excellent work, Herr General! Now, our drive to Moscow is nearly complete. Also, the General Staff has successfully persuaded the Fuhrer to resume the manufacture of guns and tanks; so now in a matter of months, we will again have the ability to upgrade into the latest equipment.

Strock: Herr General, I want you to take some of your units, along with an attachment from General Strauss' 9.Armee, and lead the advance party to capture Moscow. Winter is upon us and we want to end this war quickly. Good luck.
Mannheim: Sir, 9.Armee has a captured Soviet tank and artillery piece and asks us not to fire at them.
von Beck: Sir, You have achieved a great victory liberating all the Bolchevicks polytical prissoners!
Strock: Herr General, you have been selected to lead the invasion of England! Do not dissapoint us!
Debark your troops from the landing zones
Strock: Excellent work, Herr General! You have successfully established a bridgehead in English territory!

International tensions boil over into a full blown Russian invasion of Western Europe. You must stop the Red Menace from over running Berlin and push them back across the Oder. Renforcements are on the way...
Herr General you achieved what Napoleon could not do !!! You have taken the city of London!!!
Herr General you have achieved what has not been done for thousand years the conquest of Britain!!!
Herr General in order to plan an invasion of the continental USA we need a base in the Caribbean. The island of St. George has been selected. You will lead the invasion force!!!
Herr General St. George is ours!!! Your victory cements our control of the area.

Herr General you have been selected to lead an invasion of the continental USA. This unprecedented effort will entail the capture of the port-city of Savannah by an invasion force leaving from the island of St. George.  The Americans will defend up to the last men and they have powerful sea, air and land units in the area.  Good luck!!!
Herr General your great victory has secured a beachhead on American territory!!! We can have real posibilities of victory if our Japanese Allies can do the same on the west coast

Strock: Herr General you have achieved victory, but the enemy has been able to withdraw most of its forces! The General Staff has decided to put somebody more daring in command for the final battles of the war! You will retire with honors, of course!

Herr Feld-Marschall Congratulations on your promotion!!! After a series of victories both East and West on American soil we are in a position to close conclusively the fight on the southern theater. We need to capture the city of Knoxville and destroy the atomic facilities at Oak Ridge. A victory here will put final victory at hand!!!
Herr Feld-Marschall your wonderful victory has closed the fight on the southern front and your troops can be used on the final assault on the Washington area!!!

Strock: I'm glad you made it out of there in one piece. Those Americans took us completely by surprise, and we lost a lot of good men. Now we have to redeploy all of our troops and take them south. This is most unfortunate. ... Herr General, the war is over for you! You have to retire! With honors of course....
Strock: The Oberkommando der Wehrmacht is highly dissapointed with your pitiful performance Herr General! You are demoted to rank of corporal where you can do less harm!
Campaign designer: Skotska Vysocina aka Georg, 01/2009
PeGWW2 E-file: European e file v 1.02d
- The Civil war in Spain, You will command troops under general Franco.
- Fall Gelb . The Battle of France in 1940;
- The Battle of Britain, Operation Sealion;
Now it's up to you to re-build history...
Herr General, Armeegruppe Sud is attacking Warsaw. You must occupy the roads and railroads south of Warsaw. This will allow you to use Karl railguns when needed.
Playing tip: Deploy airborne units (if any) at airfield.
Good job Commander. You managed to hold the line and even send those Reds back a few miles.
Herr General, you must capture the bridge across the Vistula river.
Herr General, you must clear the banks of the Somme and Authie rivers from enemy soldiers. Near the Authie river location are standing strong enemy positions.
Playing tip: Use paratroopers along with Stukas to conquer your objectives. 88mm AT units are also very effective against fortifications...
You must defend Le Cateau city and when possible you must attack at Beamont city the French supply depot and occupy it.
Churchill refused the generous offer of the Führer. So be it...
It's a pity to be forced to crush this great nation of conquerors we admire so much.
You must destroy airfields, other city defenses, RAF, land and navy units. Beware that islanders are defending their homes.
Our Luftwaffe will pave the way for landings of our glorious Wehrmacht, support will be given by fallschirmjägers too.
(1) Land directly units on British soil (on British soil deploy then move your units in order to allow the landing of others)
(2) Use paratroopers from airfields in France.
Our right flank must be secured before Operation Barbarossa.
General Student and his Fallschirmjäger must occupy the island.
NB: After this operation -due to losses encountered-, Hitler never approved anymore large scale airborne operations...
Encircle all soviet units near Minsk and destroy them. You must be as swift as an arrow because our units must quickly move to Smolensk, Viazma and Moscow...
The 21st Red army defends the bridges, you must occupy all the bridges and hold them as long as the relief comes.

The 50st Red army is defending the Bryansk area. You must attack the  Bryansk and Orel city areas and break down the resistance of the Soviet army - especially tank brigades and strong artillery batteries.
Final attack on Moscow. The Winter war in Soviet Union is a very hard battle on the Eastern front.

We have a chance for victory over Red army, but enemy resistance will be very strong. Soviet units from Siberia are tough troops. Bad weather, the severe frost, difficult trackless ground... in short it is a pure Soviet battlefield.
you must hold all your positions until further notice.

The Soviets counterattack from the west and the east. Be careful, Soviet tank units will attack your position. Look toward the brunt of the battle being in the south-east and east. The second attack will come in the northwest. You must repel ground attacks and occupy two bridges on Kharkov river in order to secure our units attacking Voronez and the city of Stalingrad.
you must cross the Liska and Don rivers then occupy the bridges near Kalach.
WWII ½: Drive into Poland - August 2, 1945
General, we've got to keep the pressure on Ivan.
This is the same ground Guderian crossed in 8 days in 1939.
You should be able to do better.
Your performance was pathetic and you cannot stay in charge in this campaign. The Allies have taken the Gustav Line and Rome is about to fall.

The biggest tank battle of all time wis about to begin. Soviet tank armies, infantry, heavy artillery and Red air force will render your task highly difficult. Soviet defences are strong, they have fortified the area and have the resolution to hold it at all cost.

The attack on north and north-east line of operations on Zhukovka and Turgenevo cities is now about to start. If you can close nearer to Tula we could launch an attack on Moscow this year. Make this happen!
A huge battle against the last Soviet units is about to begin, the Red army will fight to the finish and has countless forces. Unfortunately bad weather conditions are on its side like in 1941...
Hell, this is the biggest counter-offensive against Armeegruppe Mitte so far!!!

The Soviet attacks Berlin, Stalin has put Zhukov and Koniev into competition for the fall of the Capital city of the Reich. You must put an end to this plan and defeat both Soviet armies, Berlin will be the place where Stalin was stopped!!!
Ivan crossed the Oder river, you must stop this onslaught otherwise this is the end of our glorious Reich!
The German forces attempt to cut the Eastern United States in half, while the Americans try to hold onto Knoxville, site of the gold reserves.
Comrade General you have achieved a great success! The enemy has surrendered and the gate for Moldavia is open! STAVKA is very pleased with your command of the operation!
We have the silos. Our forces will have to rest before we can restart the drive
to Moscow... Let's hope Stalin doesn't have any more secret weapons.
With the bridges cut, the supply of Soviet materials have been cut down to a trickle. Good job Commander. However, I am now aware that your presence is requested back in the Seelow Heights.
General you narrowly achieved victory and closed the mountain passes to the Soviet troops !!! They will have to agree to an armistice now !!!

Commander, jolly good performance!  I think something stronger than tea is appropriate after your capture of Nancy.  Now, the door is open for our invasion of Germany.  Do you know, there's been talk, merely rumor at this stage, of honours, possibly a knighthood?  Coffee?
Excellent! The spy has been quickly extracted, and the area secured.  Soon we shall find out what he has learned over the past three months.
Good Work, the British have been withdrawn from the Portsmouth area!, and now, we can build here our HQ and start receiving supplies from the Continental soil.

The Great Stalin himself congratulates you and your devoted young troops; you are true Communists.  The fascists are fleeing before us, and now our army has successfully crossed the Dnepr.  Very good work, Comrade.
We have reached the Atlantic coasts of France, the Allies and the survivors from the French army are embarking to England. Stalin has naming you as one of the peoples heroes after this action.
The Germans try to open the gate to Moscow at Klin, while the Soviet
forces attempt to slam it closed.
The Axis players take on the Allied players.
If your performance does not improve, we will be forced to retire you. The spy is badly wounded. Only time will tell if he will live.
The Soviets attempt to destroy the German-Romanian troops surrounded at Sevastopol.
PeG-WW2 Campaign: Mark Kirby, 01/06/2000 and Robert Mary, 03/01/2009
Comrade General you have stopped the German offensive. The enemy cannot release the Sixth Army! The Sixth Army is now doomed! The Rodina is safe!
Comrade General your success has trapped and destroyed important German troops at the city of Cherkassy! STAVKA is very pleased with your command of the operation!
Commander, it appears that once again High Command has grossly underestimated the ability of the Soviet forces to bounce back.
You are facing another Russian offensive. They have broken through our front lines and are now bearing down on your position. You must meet this offensive and force it back.
Playing tip: purchase paratroopers (with jeep so that they can move next turn after landing), then drop them to recapture lost VHs after a big bombing by tactical bombers...
You take command of Elite German SS PanzerDivisions from the civil war in Spain, to the blitzkrieg victories of early World War II, and then to the tough battles with the Allies later in the war.
This is a very tough and lengthy campaign !

After many days of hard fighting in the northern part of Sicily elements of the Italian division "Aosta" and the 15th Panzergrenadier managed to briefly stop the overwhelming advance of Pattons forces. Patton was forced to replace the 3rd Infantry Division with the 45th because very high losses amongst his men. Meanwhile Patton was also concentring a large amount of artillery to try to break the Axis lines at Etna. Your mission is to stop the American advance and give the Axis time to evacuate the stationed troops on Sicily.
You have to resist sixteen turns in order to archieve victory. On the last turn for BV a unit will appear. Use this unit to take the goal next to it.
The Soviets attack the Eighth Italian Army to threaten the flanks of Von Manstein relief force.
An Axis defeat here will mean the end of Winter Storm and the doom of Sixth Army.

During the first days of August 1943 the German army evacuated 100.000 men and 10.000 vehicles stationed on Sicily. This represented a terrible failure for the Allies. You have to take advantage of the Allied mistakes.

Delay the Allied advance on the north and south of Sicily and take control over the harbour of Messina (place units on the four port hexes (18,11); (17,11); (17,12); (18,13)) and prepare an escape route through Bagnara (ferry a unit across and occupy hex (35,4)).

Move units from PORT hexes ("Messina Harbour") to PORT hexes ("Reggio C. Harbour", "Villa S.G. Harbour") via the "strategic transport" button (see lower left button of any unit when right-clicking on it).

On September 9th Vietinghoff was unable to establish comunication with Kesselring and give orders to the 14th Panzerkorps to quickly concentrate all forces in Salerno and try to eliminate the beachhead. As a result the Allies managed to disembark several divisions.
